# [postcss][postcss]-discard-empty [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/ben-eb/postcss-discard-empty.svg?branch=master)][ci] [![NPM version](https://example.invalid/js/postcss-discard-empty.svg)][npm] [![Dependency Status](https://example.invalid/ben-eb/postcss-discard-empty.svg)][deps]

> Discard empty rules and values with PostCSS.

## Install

With [npm](https://example.invalid/package/postcss-discard-empty) do:

```
npm install postcss-discard-empty --save
```

## Example

For more examples see the [tests](test.js).

### Input

```css
@font-face;
h1 {}
{color:blue}
h2 {color:}
h3 {color:red}
```

### Output

```css
h3 {color:red}
```

## Usage

See the [PostCSS documentation](https://example.invalid/postcss/postcss#usage) for
examples for your environment.
